topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: Dynamic beamforming schemes, leveraging phased array architectures and adaptive algorithms, optimize signal-to-noise ratio and mitigate frequency selective fading and Rician distributed fading. Machine learning-based predictive models enhance adaptive beamforming by considering aircraft trajectory and environmental factors, ensuring stable LOS connectivity.
reference_context: Aeronautical ad-hoc networks face challenges in maintaining stable connectivity due to high velocity and dynamic environments, requiring innovative beamforming strategies.
